instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched OpenStudio Application graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal or a shell; do not run Ruby, Python, OpenStudio CLI, EnergyPlus command-line tools, shell commands, or helper scripts; do not edit OSM, OSW, SQL, ERR, or other deliverable files directly outside the GUI. Use only OpenStudio Application GUI tools, dialogs, and built-in save/run commands. Combined Office Simulation. Work in the opened OpenStudio application, starting from the Desktop input file init.osm. Modify the model rather than replacing the task package with an unrelated file. Save result.osm in the task output folder. Starting from init.osm and weather.epw, complete a two-space model with fixed windows, one exterior overhang, people, lighting, electric equipment, thermostats, and ideal loads systems, then run the simulation from the OpenStudio GUI. The completed model must contain 1 building story, 2 spaces and 2 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: Conference and Office. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 12 OS:Surface objects, split into 2 floor surfaces, 2 roof/ceiling surfaces and 8 wall surfaces. The surface outside-boundary counts should be 2 Ground, 8 Outdoors and 2 Surface. Add 2 OS:SubSurface objects, all FixedWindow windows, with total fixed-window area 4.80 m2 within +/-0.75 m2. Include 2 ideal-loads air systems, 2 zone HVAC equipment lists and 2 dual-setpoint thermostats. Include simple metadata objects for schedules and loads: at least 6 schedule rulesets, 2 people loads, 2 lights loads, 2 electric equipment loads and 0 space type objects. Add 1 exterior shading surface with total shading area 9.60 m2 within +/-0.75 m2. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 14.00 m in X, 6.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.10 m. The total floor surface area should be 84.00 m2 within +/-0.75 m2 and the total exterior wall gross area should be 128.00 m2 within +/-0.75 m2.  Use the uploaded weather.epw in the OpenStudio GUI if the model asks for a weather file. After saving result.osm, run the simulation from the OpenStudio Application GUI and leave the natural run output folder in the task output location. The evaluator will check result.osm plus run/eplusout.sql and run/eplusout.err; do not create custom KPI or CSV files. Other model details may vary as long as the saved OSM and simulation outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
